tasks.label: ⚡ Update Extensions List
tasks.detail: Updates src/.vscode/extensions.txt with your currently installed extensions.

tasks.label: 🧪 Open Playground
tasks.detail: Opens the playground file to test fonts and colors.

tasks.label: 🚀 Start Local Server
tasks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -m http.server 8000 || python -m http.server 8000

args: if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -m http.server 8000 } else { python -m http.server 8000 }

tasks.detail: Serves the current directory on http://localhost:8000 using the available Python launcher.

tasks.label: 🔍 Find TODOs
tasks.command: find . \( -name node_modules -o -name .git -o -name dist -o -name build -o -name coverage \) -prune -o -type f -exec grep -nIE "TODO|FIXME" {} + || test $? -eq 1
tasks.detail: Scans the entire project for TODO and FIXME comments, ignoring common build folders.
